text:
Mike: Quick heads-up — quantized 4bit bring-up of model-x on canary shows ~5% drop on slot-fill prompts vs fp16 on our internal eval. Need to triage + refresh golden set and relabel borderline cases. @Julie can you spare label capacity?

Julie: On it. How many examples and which cohorts are we looking at?

Mike: ~1200 flagged by the regression detector. Breakdown: 400 named-entity slots, 500 multi-step instructions, 300 paraphrase/ambiguity cases. Signal strongest in entity normalization (dates/currencies/abbrevs).

Sara: Do we have fuzzy de-dup applied? Could be dupes inflating the counts.

Mike: We currently dedupe by id only. Suggest we run fuzzy text dedupe at ~92% similarity then cluster before sampling.

Ken: I'll kick off a fuzzy dedupe job. Quick SQL/snippet I'll use: 
```sql
SELECT id, text, other_id, levenshtein_norm(text, other_text) as sim 
FROM prompts_candidates 
WHERE sim > 0.92;
```
Then cluster with minhash LSH and collapse clusters to one canonical example.

Julie: After dedupe we should surface ~300 golden candidates prioritized by (1) disagreement score, (2) model_delta, (3) client impact. Can we tag them in LabelFlow as priority:high? :fire:

LabelBot: Created 300 tasks in LabelFlow workspace 'ml_golden_refresh' and assigned to julie + labelers. Tasks: LF-3981..LF-4280.

Anya: Also — we need a small rubric tweak: explicitly call out entity canonicalization rules (dates -> ISO, currencies -> 3-letter codes, common abbrevs). I'll drop a draft in /docs/golden-rubric.md and ping you all.

Sara: For sampling, prefer low-confidence outputs + heavy-hitter clients. Draft query: 
```sql
SELECT * FROM eval_runs 
WHERE platform_confidence < 0.6 OR client_request_count > 50 
ORDER BY model_delta DESC 
LIMIT 800;
```
This should bias toward useful cases.

Julie: Also we should avoid relabeling high-agreement items. Only send if current labeler_disagreement >= 2 OR delta_score > 0.03. That trims the batch a lot.

Mike: Agreed. We'll keep the rest for broader QA. Important: capture before+after metrics. Run the quant4b model through the eval harness against both the old golden and the refreshed candidate set.

Ken: Starting dedupe job now, ETA ~2h. Will push output to S3: s3://redwood-ml/curation/modelx/quant4b/dedupe/1779000123.csv

LabelBot: Reminder: relabel batch assigned to 6 labelers, estimated throughput 100 labels/day, ETA ~72 hours.

Julie: Ack. We'll do an initial pass first 24h then run an SME adjudication pass for ties and tricky canonicalization.

Anya: One more ask — add a small targeted set (~50) of hard prompting edgecases (nested entities, overlapping slots) to the Canary smoke suite so future rollouts fail fast.

Mike: Good call. I'll add the smoke tests and wire alerts to #eng-oncall. If anyone sees a big cluster with the same failure mode ping the channel and attach examples. Thanks all :thumbsup:
